summary: The legal array has at most 100 elements from a fixed 201-value domain, so complete-domain runtime scaling cannot reliably distinguish bounded counting from optimized native comparison sorting.

workload_bound.source_constraint: nums has length from 1 through 100 inclusive, and every value is between -100 and 100

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation performs one frequency update per input element, visits exactly 201 fixed value buckets, and emits each of the n occurrences once, for O(n + 201) work.
Authored cases cover one element, zero, duplicate values, all-equal magnitudes, opposite signs, arbitrary tie order through a property validator, reverse magnitudes, and both -100 and 100.
